Opening note: 'The explicit goal of the Worthy Successor thought experiment is to steward forward the living process – and to overtly prevent a brute takeover from an AGI that is a squasher of that living process rather than a participant and expand-er of it. In 14+ long years of writing ... “successionism” hasn’t once been my take.' Body: '...so this is be no means advocacy for a hard break from biology to compute ...' / 'That said, AGI would almost certainly be essential for the project – and Kurzweil is almost certainly right that in the longer term non-biological substrates will be more prominent and important for carrying forth life’s flourishing than any eternal commitment today’s biological substrates.' FAQ 7: 'We may be part of the successor in much the same way...'. Capture finding as recorded in research/heterodox-thought/cross-family-check-2026-10-31.md (web.archive.org is unreachable from here): 'Current W02 BCI wording/conclusion, item 117’s Kurzweil sentence and both item 77 slowdown passages are absent verbatim.'
corrections.reason: Confirmed. The record contradicts itself. The qualification opens 'The cross-family check found these passages in an archive capture of 26 February 2024', but the record's attested.note, the source's version note and the cross-family report all say the capture lacks the Kurzweil sentence. The report (research/heterodox-thought/cross-family-check-2026-10-31.md, Faggella row) says 'item 117’s Kurzweil sentence ... absent verbatim', and the W01 evidence passage is that same sentence. The admission map (review/heterodox-admission-map-2026-11-01.json, captures.faggella-2023-worthy-successor) shows where the error came from: the capture note was put in place of the pack's 'The wording is attested from the 2026 update.' on every Faggella record. That is right for W10, whose passages the check found in the capture (item 86), and wrong for W01 and W02. Replacing that sentence left 'That update's opening note' with nothing to refer to. I re-read the current page on 2026-11-01 (dated November 24, 2023 and updated October 15, 2026). Every other sentence in the qualification is true there: the successionism sentence and the brute-takeover clause are in the opening note, the 'hard break from biology to compute' sentence comes right before the evidence paragraph, and 'We may be part of the successor' is in FAQ 7. In the corrected qualification I made two further changes. First, I quote the brute-takeover clause in full: the source continues 'from an AGI that is a squasher of that living process', and the clipped quote makes a restricted claim read as general, which matters on a succession record. Second, I say 'In that version' instead of naming the update, because the capture shows only that the opening note was added after February 2024, not that the 15 October 2026 update added it. The statement left out 'Kurzweil is almost certainly right that', so a hedged view credited to Kurzweil read as Faggella's flat assertion. 'more prominent than biological ones' also reworded a garbled comparison in the source ('than any eternal commitment today’s biological substrates'). The new statement follows the evidence quote word for word up to 'flourishing'. The subject, predicate, object and proposition are unchanged, so the ID stays. The record is already on main (it is in release v0.23.1 and v0.23.2), so the correction must be recorded in a tracked review note, as the policy requires.
